column4: Transfer to Line 2 at the next station.
column5:
Conj: 갈아타요 · 갈아탔어요 · 갈아탈 거예요 · 갈아타는 N · 갈아타서

column4: I was late because I missed the bus.
column5:
Conj: 놓쳐요 · 놓쳤어요 · 놓칠 거예요 · 놓치는 N · 놓쳐서
Use: N을/를 놓치다 · 버스를 놓치다, 기회를 놓치다

column4: I'll stop by the convenience store on my way home.
column5:
Conj: 들러요 · 들렀어요 · 들를 거예요 · 들르는 N · 들러서 (으 irregular)
Use: N에 들르다 · 잠깐 들르다, 가는 길에 들르다

column4: Did you pack your passport?
column5:
Conj: 챙겨요 · 챙겼어요 · 챙길 거예요 · 챙기는 N · 챙겨서

column4: I get carsick if I ride the bus for a long time.
column5:
Conj: 멀미해요 · 멀미했어요 · 멀미할 거예요 · 멀미하는 N · 멀미해서
Use: 멀미가 나다 · 차멀미, 뱃멀미

column4: It was my first time in that area, so I got lost.
column5:
Conj: 잃어요 · 잃었어요 · 잃을 거예요 · 잃는 N · 잃어서
Use: 길을 잃다 · 길을 잃어버리다 (more emphatic)
cf) 잊다 = forget (different word)

column4: I had more luggage than I thought.
column5: Use: 짐을 싸다 (pack), 짐을 풀다 (unpack), 짐을 맡기다 (leave your bags)

column4: I already booked a place to stay.
column5: Use: 숙소를 잡다, 숙소를 예약하다 · covers hotels, Airbnbs, guesthouses

column4: It's cheaper to buy a round trip.
column5: Use: 왕복 표, 왕복 두 시간 · opposite: 편도 (one way)

column4: It'll probably be busy, so book in advance.
column5: Use: 미리 말하다, 미리 준비하다 · goes before the verb

column4: I've gotten really into pickleball lately.
column5:
Conj: 빠져요 · 빠졌어요 · 빠질 거예요 · 빠지는 N · 빠져서
Use: N에 빠지다 · 게임에 빠지다, 사랑에 빠지다
cf) also means fall out, skip (수업에 빠지다)

column2: get sick of, get tired of
column4: After doing it every day, I got a bit sick of it.
column5:
Conj: 질려요 · 질렸어요 · 질릴 거예요 · 질리는 N · 질려서
Use: N에 질리다, N이/가 질리다 · 음식이 질리다

column4: As I kept practicing, my skills improved.
column5:
Conj: 늘어요 · 늘었어요 · 늘 거예요 · 느는 N · 늘어서 (ㄹ irregular)
Use: N이/가 늘다 · 실력이 늘다, 몸무게가 늘다

column4: I'm thinking of trying knitting this time.
column5:
Conj: 도전해요 · 도전했어요 · 도전할 거예요 · 도전하는 N · 도전해서
Use: N에 도전하다 · 새로운 일에 도전하다

column4: I watched a YouTube video and followed along.
column5:
Conj: 따라 해요 · 따라 했어요 · 따라 할 거예요 · 따라 하는 N · 따라 해서
Use: N을/를 따라 하다 · 춤을 따라 하다

column4: Your skills are good for a beginner.
column5: Use: 실력이 늘다, 실력이 좋다, 한국어 실력

column4: You're a really good cook.
column5:
Use: 솜씨가 좋다, 요리 솜씨, 손재주 (dexterity)
cf) 실력 = general ability · 솜씨 = handiwork, cooking

column4: I joined a tennis club.
column5: Use: 동호회에 가입하다, 동호회 사람들

column4: Doing it steadily every day is what matters.
column5: Use: 꾸준히 운동하다, 꾸준히 공부하다

column4: It was so fun I lost track of time.
column5: Use: almost always past: 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요 · with #10 -(으)ㄴ/는 줄 몰랐다

column4: We got close from working together.

Conj: 친해져요 · 친해졌어요 · 친해질 거예요 · 친해지는 N · 친해져서

column4: It was a bit awkward at first.

Conj: 어색해요 · 어색했어요 · 어색할 거예요 · 어색한 N · 어색해서

column4: I had a bit of an argument with my sibling yesterday.
column5:
Conj: 다퉈요 · 다퉜어요 · 다툴 거예요 · 다투는 N · 다퉈서
Use: N하고/와 다투다
cf) 싸우다 = fight, argue (more common, stronger)

column4: I heard you already made up?
column5:
Conj: 화해해요 · 화해했어요 · 화해할 거예요 · 화해하는 N · 화해해서
Use: N하고/와 화해하다

Conj: 끊겨요 · 끊겼어요 · 끊길 거예요 · 끊기는 N · 끊겨서

Conj: 부러워요 · 부러웠어요 · 부러울 거예요 · 부러운 N · 부러워서 (ㅂ irregular)
Use: N이/가 부럽다 · 부러워하다 (about someone else's feelings)

column4: Those two seem to get along well.
column5: Use: 사이가 좋다/나쁘다, 친구 사이, 무슨 사이예요?

column4: They're a cheerful person.
column5: Use: 성격이 좋다, 성격이 잘 맞다

column5: Use: 고민이 있다, 고민하다 (think hard about, agonize), 고민 상담

column5: Use: starts the sentence · 솔직히 말하면 (to be honest)

cf) 춥다 = cold (stronger)

column4: Summer is hard because it's so humid.

Conj: 습해요 · 습했어요 · 습할 거예요 · 습한 N · 습해서

Conj: 흐려요 · 흐렸어요 · 흐릴 거예요 · 흐린 N · 흐려서

Conj: 그쳐요 · 그쳤어요 · 그칠 거예요 · 그치는 N · 그쳐서

column4: It suddenly started pouring, so I went into a café.
column5:
Conj: 쏟아져요 · 쏟아졌어요 · 쏟아질 거예요 · 쏟아지는 N · 쏟아져서
Use: 비가 쏟아지다, 잠이 쏟아지다 (get really sleepy)

column4: I heard it's going to warm up starting this week.
column5:
Conj: 풀려요 · 풀렸어요 · 풀릴 거예요 · 풀리는 N · 풀려서

column5: Use: 단풍이 들다 (leaves change color), 단풍 구경

column2: temperature difference between day and night
column4: The temperature swings a lot between day and night these days.
column5: Use: 일교차가 크다 · common in weather talk in fall

column4: Maybe because the seasons are changing, I caught a cold.
column5: Use: 환절기에는 감기 조심하세요 · often with health talk

column3: 너무 몰입해서 밥 먹는 것도 잊었어요.
column4: I was so absorbed I even forgot to eat.
column5:
Conj: 몰입해요 · 몰입했어요 · 몰입할 거예요 · 몰입하는 N · 몰입해서
Use: N에 몰입하다 · 몰입감 (immersion)

column4: It got a bit boring in the middle.
column5:
Conj: 지루해요 · 지루했어요 · 지루할 거예요 · 지루한 N · 지루해서
Use: 영화가 지루하다
cf) 심심하다 = bored (you have nothing to do)

column4: I got goosebumps at the last scene.
column5:
Conj: 돋아요 · 돋았어요 · 돋을 거예요 · 돋는 N · 돋아서
Use: for fear, cold, or being amazed · short: 소름!

Conj: 정주행해요 · 정주행했어요 · 정주행할 거예요 · 정주행하는 N · 정주행해서

column4: It was more worth watching than I expected.

Conj: 볼만해요 · 볼만했어요 · 볼만할 거예요 · 볼만한 N · 볼만해서
Use: 볼만한 영화 · same pattern: 먹을 만하다, 갈 만하다

column4: The ending was a bit disappointing.

column4: The plot is a bit confusing.
column5: Use: 줄거리를 말하다, 간단한 줄거리

column4: The lead actor's performance was really good.
column5: Use: 주인공을 맡다 (play the lead), 남자 주인공, 여자 주인공

column4: No spoilers!
column5: Use: 스포하다, 스포를 당하다 (get spoiled) · short for 스포일러

column4: As expected, that director's movies are good.
column5: Use: when something matches what you expected · also a reaction: 역시!

column4: I don't know what to pick.
column5:
Conj: 골라요 · 골랐어요 · 고를 거예요 · 고르는 N · 골라서 (르 irregular)
Use: N을/를 고르다 · 선물을 고르다
cf) 선택하다 = more formal

column4: It didn't fit, so I exchanged it.
column5:
Conj: 교환해요 · 교환했어요 · 교환할 거예요 · 교환하는 N · 교환해서
Use: N을/를 N(으)로 교환하다 · 큰 사이즈로 교환하다

column2: suit, look good on, hang out with
column4: That color really suits you.
column5:
Conj: 어울려요 · 어울렸어요 · 어울릴 거예요 · 어울리는 N · 어울려서
Use: N에게/한테 어울리다 · N하고 어울리다 (hang out with)

column4: I was going to buy it, but it's already sold out.
column5:
Conj: 품절돼요 · 품절됐어요 · 품절될 거예요 · 품절되는 N · 품절돼서
Use: 품절이다 · 매진되다 = sold out for tickets

column4: I did the grocery shopping on my way home from work.
column5:
Conj: 봐요 · 봤어요 · 볼 거예요 · 보는 N · 봐서
Use: 마트에서 장을 보다 · 장보기 (grocery shopping, noun)

column4: I'll get the bill.
column5:
Conj: 계산해요 · 계산했어요 · 계산할 거예요 · 계산하는 N · 계산해서
Use: 카드로 계산하다 · 따로 계산하다 (pay separately)

column4: My package still hasn't come.
column5: Use: 택배가 오다, 택배를 보내다/받다, 택배 기사님

column4: It had free shipping, so I ordered it.
column5: Use: 배송비 (shipping fee), 배송이 늦다, 배송 조회 (tracking)

column4: I put it in my cart.
column5: Use: 장바구니에 담다 · works for online carts and reusable bags

column2: just in time, as it happened
column4: It just happened to be on sale, so I bought one.
column5: Use: 마침 잘됐네요 (perfect timing!) · something lucky lines up

column4: Even when I memorize words, I keep forgetting them.
column5:
Conj: 외워요 · 외웠어요 · 외울 거예요 · 외우는 N · 외워서
Use: N을/를 외우다 · 단어를 외우다, 전화번호를 외우다

column4: I've gotten used to the Korean keyboard now.

Conj: 익숙해요 · 익숙했어요 · 익숙할 거예요 · 익숙한 N · 익숙해서
Use: N에 익숙하다 · 익숙해지다 (get used to)

column4: I heard you passed the exam! Congrats!
column5:
Conj: 붙어요 · 붙었어요 · 붙을 거예요 · 붙는 N · 붙어서
Use: 시험에 붙다 · cf) 합격하다 = more formal

column4: I'm worried I might fail.
column5:
Conj: 떨어져요 · 떨어졌어요 · 떨어질 거예요 · 떨어지는 N · 떨어져서
Use: 시험에 떨어지다 · 돈이 떨어지다 (run out of money)

column4: I always review before bed.
column5:
Conj: 복습해요 · 복습했어요 · 복습할 거예요 · 복습하는 N · 복습해서
Use: N을/를 복습하다 · opposite: 예습하다 (prepare ahead)

column4: I got the same question wrong again.
column5:
Conj: 틀려요 · 틀렸어요 · 틀릴 거예요 · 틀리는 N · 틀려서
Use: N을/를 틀리다 · 답이 틀리다
cf) 다르다 = different (not wrong)

column4: It's okay to make mistakes.
column5: Use: 실수하다, 실수를 고치다, 같은 실수를 하다

column4: I've gained confidence in speaking lately.
column5: Use: 자신감이 생기다/있다/없다 · 자신 있다 (be confident)

column4: My goal this year is TOPIK level 4.
column5: Use: 목표를 세우다 (set a goal), 목표를 이루다 (reach a goal)

column3: 아무래도 내일 다시 해야 할 것 같아요.
column4: I guess I'll have to do it again tomorrow.
column5: Use: with a guess or decision: 아무래도 -(으)ㄹ 것 같다 · weighs things up before concluding
